Deep within a high-rise hotel in Kamihama lies a forbidden labyrinth of pleasure—"Casino Magica." Across four distinct floors, the stakes rise and the desires grow darker as one ascends.

■ 1F: Casual Gem
The radiant gateway to the night. Here, magical girls like Sayaka, Felicia, and Kyoko greet guests in dazzling bunny suits, transforming raw desire into "wholesome play." Their devoted service creates a perfect illusion of a pure and innocent playground.
However, beyond the heavy doors at the edge of the floor, a sweet, dense aroma begins to drift, drowning out the lively noise of the first floor...
